name: Gitea API
tagline: GitHub-compatible REST API for self-hosted Git forge management
description: Gitea is a lightweight, self-hostable Git forge written in Go. Its REST API (OpenAPI-documented) covers repositories, issues, pull requests, organizations, users, and more—providing a GitHub-like surface without vendor lock-in. Hosted instances (e.g. gitea.com) and self-hosted servers both expose the same API under /api/v1.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header, or query param ?token=. Create tokens in user Settings > Applications. Basic auth and OAuth2 also supported.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-hosted: unlimited free (open source). gitea.com hosted: free public accounts; paid plans for private/org features—exact hosted quotas not centrally published as API rate cards.
pricing.paid_plans: Self-hosted is free (MIT). Commercial support and hosted plans via Gitea Ltd / Cloudron / third parties; check gitea.com and company site for current hosted pricing.

rate_limits: No fixed requests-per-minute/hour default is documented for the current Gitea API. Self-hosted operators may impose deployment-level controls; built-in QoS overload protection is separate and disabled by default. gitea.com's service-specific quota is not publicly documented.
use_cases: list repositories for a user or organization
create or update issues and pull requests
manage org teams and repo collaborators
clone/push automation via repo metadata and deploy keys
search users, repos, and issues on a Gitea instance
mirror or sync repo settings across self-hosted forges
